cards.prompt:
A premium hardcover book front cover design, flat layout, portrait 3:4 aspect ratio, for a Chinese technical book series titled "AI Agent 工程".

Composition: deep navy matte background fills the entire cover. At the center, an abstract constellation: a small glowing amber core node hovers above a neat stack of luminous cyan document planes (a curated "document brain"), while faint scattered dust-like fragments drift away to one side, like uncurated memory snippets dissolving into the dark. Fine luminous threads connect the core to a few amber nodes and down into the document stack, suggesting an agent consulting its own notes before acting. A subtle blueprint grid texture fades into the background. The overall mood: engineered clarity rising out of noise.

Typography: centered in the upper-middle, the bold Chinese title "AI Agent 工程" in large ivory serif type with generous letter-spacing. Below the title, a thin amber horizontal rule with a tiny glowing center dot. Beneath the rule, smaller subtitle text in clean ivory sans-serif: "从记忆到文档，拆开 Agent 的每一次思考". At the very bottom, small ivory text: "数解AI".

No barcode, no price, no author photo, no ISBN, no dust jacket texture, no realistic human, no window reflections. Clean, editorial, premium book design — the kind you'd see on a technical publisher's catalog cover.

Absolutely no other visible words, letters, equations, logos, or watermarks beyond the specified Chinese text above.
